summary: Completed backend+frontend regression for public catalog privacy and admin user-capacity management. Verified public payload/UI no longer expose stock/status, user creation and RBAC flows work, max-10 limit is enforced (including concurrency), and temporary test accounts were cleaned back to admin-only state.
action_items: No functional blocker found in this scope; keep new regression tests in CI for public allowlist, max-10 capacity, and concurrent account creation.
Consider replacing broad legacy backend_test.py assertions that still expect old public status payloads.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/tests/backend_test.py still contains obsolete assertions for public endpoints (expects status/status_counts) and a hardcoded BASE_URL fallback; this can generate false failures and hides env misconfiguration.
backend/server.py remains >700 lines and mixes multiple domains (auth, stock, exports, startup/seed), increasing regression risk for future security/capacity changes.

success_rate.backend: 100% (7/7 in new regression + 4/4 auth spot checks)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested public + pengguna flows validated

seed_data_creation: Created temporary users for UI/API validation (iter5_gudang, iter5_opname, iter5full_*). All removed by exact IDs/usernames; capacity returned to 1/10.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Database is back to only main admin (verified /api/users/capacity => total 1). Public page checks passed for search/filter/empty/error-retry/mobile overflow and no stock/status leakage. Non-admin and anonymous restrictions for /api/users and /api/users/capacity were validated (403/401).
rca of the issue: No new product bug found in this scope. One pre-existing test brittleness was identified and fixed in test_admin_auth_public_regression preflight assertion to accept explicit echoed origin from configured allowlist, avoiding false negatives caused by environment-specific preview origins.
